BSE Limited 
National Stock Exchange of India Limited 
 
Corporate Services Department 
Corporate Communications Department 
 
Phiroze Jeejeebhoy Towers,

Dalal Street, Mumbai – 400001 
Bandra (East), Mumbai - 400051 
 
BSE Scrip Code: 512455 
NSE Symbol: LLOYDSME 
 
 
Sub: 
Intimation of Audio Recording of Earnings Conference Call for Q1FY27 
 
Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
Pursuant to the Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and 
Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (“Listing Regulations”), and in furtherance to our 
intimation dated 05th August, 2026 we would like to inform that audio recording for Conference Call 
for investors and analysts held today, i.e. Tuesday, 11th August, 2026 at 3:30 P.M. is hosted on the 
website of the Company at https://lloyds.in/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Intimation-of-Earnings-call-
recording-for-Quarter-ended-30th-June-2026.mp3  
 
Further, we would like inform that no Unpublished Price Sensitive Information (“UPSI”) was 
disclosed/shared to the Investors/Analysts during the said Conference Call. 
 
The same will also be available on the Company’s Website at www.lloyds.in.  
 
The same may please be taken on record and suitably disseminated to all concerned. 
 
Thanking you, 
Yours Sincerely,  
For Lloyds Metals and Energy Limited 
 
 
 
Akshay Vora 
Company Secretary  
 
Akshay 
Pankaj Vora
Digitally signed by 
Akshay Pankaj Vora 
Date: 2026.08.11
